seoTitle: Ted Lasso Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Ted Lasso test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Ted, Rebecca, Roy, Keeley, Jamie, Nate, Higgins or Coach Beard — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the relentless optimist, the grumpy legend, or the boss who owns every room? Answer 12 everyday questions about work, friends and second chances, and find out which Ted Lasso character you are.

characters.name: Ted Lasso
characters.title: The Believer
characters.summary: Kind, funny and relentlessly positive. You believe in people, sometimes more than they believe in themselves.
description: Like Ted, you believe in people. The American college football coach was hired to manage an English football team, despite knowing almost nothing about the sport.
You're kind, funny and relentlessly positive. He won over his boss by baking her biscuits every morning, and hung a sign that just said 'Believe' in the locker room.
Your weakness is looking after yourself. Ted helped everyone else with their problems while hiding his own panic attacks, until he finally learned to ask for help.
strengths: Brings out the best in people
characters.flaw: You look after everyone except yourself.
characters.signature: A box of homemade biscuits, a moustache and a terrible pun.
characters.clashReason: they're so relentlessly positive that you can't have a bad day in peace

characters.name: Rebecca Welton
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Sharp, elegant and in charge. You own every room you walk into.
description: Like Rebecca, you walk into a room and own it. She took AFC Richmond from her ex-husband in their divorce, and at first she hired Ted hoping he'd ruin it.
You're sharp, stylish and very funny once your guard comes down. Under the power suits, you're more vulnerable than you let people see.
Your weakness is holding a grudge. But when you finally let people in, you're one of the most loyal friends anyone could have.
characters.flaw: It takes you a very long time to let anyone in.
characters.signature: A perfect suit, a sharp one-liner and a box of biscuits you pretend not to love.
characters.clashReason: they're cool and sharp, and never let you see what they're really thinking

characters.name: Roy Kent
characters.title: The Grumpy Heart
characters.summary: Blunt, honest and fiercely loyal. Grumpy on the outside, soft on the inside.
description: Like Roy, you're grumpy on the outside and soft on the inside. The legendary Richmond captain retired, became a coach, and never once pretended to be happy about anything.
You're blunt, honest and fiercely loyal. You'll tell people exactly what you think, and you'll turn up for them every single time.
Your soft side is well hidden. Roy is at his gentlest with his young niece, Phoebe, and with the few people who've earned it.
characters.flaw: You'd rather grunt than say how you feel.
characters.signature: A scowl, a growl and a very short answer.
characters.clashReason: they're grumpy, blunt and never pretend to be happy

characters.name: Keeley Jones
characters.title: The People Person
characters.summary: Bubbly, smart and brilliant with people. You help everyone become their best self.
description: Like Keeley, you're bubbly, smart and brilliant with people. She went from being known as a model to running Richmond's marketing, then launched her own PR firm.
You're confident, warm and emotionally switched on. You notice how everyone's feeling, and you're not shy about asking.
Your weakness is doubting yourself when things get serious. But you always back your friends, and you help people become their best selves.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself when the stakes get high.
characters.signature: A great outfit, a big smile and a pep talk nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they always want to know how you're really feeling

characters.name: Jamie Tartt
characters.title: The Show-Off
characters.summary: Talented, competitive and a bit full of yourself. You want everyone to know you're the best.
description: Like Jamie, you're talented and you know it. Richmond's young star arrived on loan from Manchester City and thought the whole game revolved around him.
You're confident, competitive and a bit of a show-off. You love the spotlight, and you want everyone to know you're the best.
But you can grow. Jamie learned to pass the ball, stand up to his father and become a real teammate.
characters.flaw: You need everyone to know how good you are.
characters.signature: Perfect hair, a big ego and the ball at your feet.
characters.clashReason: they're cocky, loud and think everything is about them

characters.name: Nate Shelley
characters.title: The Overlooked Genius
characters.summary: Sharp, hard-working and desperate to be taken seriously.
description: Like Nate, you've got a brilliant mind that people keep overlooking. Richmond's shy kit man became a coach after Ted noticed his clever tactical ideas.
You're sharp, hard-working and desperate to be taken seriously. But when you finally get respect, it can go straight to your head.
Your weakness is insecurity. Nate turned his back on the people who believed in him, and had to find his way home again.
characters.flaw: You need respect so badly that you forget who gave it to you first.
characters.signature: A notebook full of tactics and a chip on your shoulder.
characters.clashReason: they're insecure, touchy and take everything personally

characters.name: Leslie Higgins
characters.title: The Nicest Man in the Room
characters.summary: Kind, reliable and family-first. You're much cooler than people realise.
description: Like Higgins, you're one of the nicest people in any room. Richmond's director of football operations spent years doing what he was told, before finding the courage to stand up for what's right.
You're kind, reliable and happiest with your family. Every Christmas, he invites the players who are far from home to join his family for dinner.
You're also cooler than people think. Higgins plays jazz on the double bass, and nobody at the club saw that coming.
characters.flaw: You go along with things for far too long before speaking up.
characters.signature: A cardigan, a double bass and a spare seat at the dinner table.
characters.clashReason: they're so eager to please that you never know what they really want

characters.name: Coach Beard
characters.title: The Mysterious Sidekick
characters.summary: Clever, loyal and a bit of an oddball. Nobody knows what you get up to after dark.
description: Like Coach Beard, you're the loyal sidekick with a mysterious side. Ted's assistant coach and best friend followed him all the way from Kansas to London.
You're clever, well-read and a bit of an oddball. Beard always has his nose in a book, and knows a surprising amount about almost everything.
Nobody quite knows what you get up to after dark. One of his nights out in London became a whole episode, and it was very strange.
characters.flaw: You're so private that even your friends barely know you.
characters.signature: A whistle, a book nobody else has read and a night out nobody would believe.
characters.clashReason: they're so strange and mysterious that you never know what they'll say next

questions.text: A new colleague is obviously nervous on their first day. You...

options.text: Learn their name and make them laugh
Give them one blunt tip, then leave them to it
Show them where everything is. Twice
Make sure they know who the star is round here

questions.text: Your manager picks your work apart in a meeting. You...

options.text: Replay it for weeks and plan the perfect comeback
Stay perfectly calm, then answer with one cutting line
Stare at them in silence until it gets awkward
Argue back. Nobody talks to you like that

questions.text: A friend sings you a song they wrote. It's not good. You...

options.text: Tell them. It's not good
Be honest, then tell them which bit actually works
Clap enthusiastically and change the subject
Say something so odd they can't tell if it was a compliment

questions.text: You've got a quiet evening at home. You spend it...

options.text: Reading something nobody else has heard of
Playing an instrument
With a face mask, a rom-com and a lot of snacks
With a glass of wine and a very long bath

questions.text: Your team at work misses a big target. You...

options.text: Remind everyone it's about the people, not the numbers
Point out exactly whose fault it was
Take responsibility. Fixing it is your job
Quietly draw up a new plan while everyone else talks

questions.text: An old friend who let you down years ago gets in touch to say sorry. You...

options.text: Thank them, but you're not ready to forgive
Grunt, then forgive them without ever saying so
Forgive them. Holding on only hurts you
Meet for a coffee and hear them out properly

questions.text: Your boss offers you the job above yours, and you've only been there six months. You...

options.text: Take it, and act like you always deserved it
Say you're not ready yet. Maybe next year
About time. You're brilliant
Say yes, and ask for training straight away

questions.text: A friend is in a bad mood and won't talk about it. You...

options.text: Keep gently asking until they open up
Make terrible jokes until they crack a smile
Sit next to them in silence. That's enough
Take them out for a night they'll never forget

questions.text: There's a fancy dress party on Saturday. You...

options.text: Go all out. You'll have the best costume there
Wear something elegant and call it a costume
Go as something that shows off your arms
Turn up in your normal clothes

questions.text: Your pub quiz team keeps losing. You...

options.text: Keep it fun. Winning isn't the point
Study the other teams and work out how to beat them
Answer every question yourself
Bring snacks and cheer everyone on

questions.text: You manage a struggling football team. Your star player is brilliant, but completely selfish. You...

options.text: Believe in them, and help them grow up
Tell them exactly how selfish they are, loudly
Bench them until they learn their place
Sell them for as much money as you can

questions.text: You work at a football club. A bigger rival offers you a great job, but it means leaving the people who gave you your first chance. You...

options.text: Take it. You've waited long enough to be respected
Say no. Loyalty matters more than money
Stay. You'd follow your best friend anywhere
Go. Bigger club, bigger stage
